recognize_zh: 三顆中型淋巴球，胞質嗜鹼性且無顆粒，核圓到略不規則，可見小核仁（箭頭），核質比中等，呈 T-PLL 的前淋巴球型態。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than normal small lymphocytes
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Moderate rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with slightly irregular outline
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and a small visible nucleolus (arrow). The cytoplasm is moderate, basophilic and agranular with a slightly irregular border. No hairy projections or cerebriform nuclei are seen. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (mature T-cell, TCL1 overexpression).

ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes have a larger, more prominent central nucleolus and paler cytoplasm, with B-cell phenotype.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and are typically CD7-negative and CD26-negative.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous in size with abundant cytoplasm indenting around red cells and lack a clonal T-cell population.
